hero-description:
PERSONAL
	Lord, help me to walk in Your light, living in purity and truth.
	Cleanse me from all sin and fill me with Your Spirit.
	Strengthen me to resist temptation and to live a life that honors You.
	Restore and deepen my relationship with You.
FAMILY
	Lord, let Your light shine in my home and guide my family.
	Unite us in love, peace, and faith.
	Protect our family from the attacks of the enemy.
	Help us to be a light in our community and to teach our children Your ways.
CHURCH
	Lord, we pray for our church to walk in Your light and truth.
	Cleanse us from any unrighteousness and fill us with Your Spirit.
	Unite and strengthen our leaders and congregation in Your love.
	Let our church be a shining light for Jesus in the community.
